subject: Security architecture review — SOC 2 evidence kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.j@clearwave.com>
Cc: Olga PetroV <olga.p@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Security architecture review — SOC 2 evidence kickoff

Hi Alice —

Thanks for taking this through with us. We'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive to walk your security and engineering teams through Redwood's controls and to collect the SOC 2 evidence artifacts we'll need for your compliance review. Proposed agenda (can trim to 45 min if helpful):

- 5m quick intros + scope
- 20m architecture walkthrough (network, VPC, KMS, encryption at rest/in transit)
- 15m SSO & identity (Okta SAML, SCIM provisioning, session policies)
- 10m audit logs & retention (audit log forwarding, retention windows, access controls)
- 10m evidence matrix review & next steps

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Wed Jul 30, 10:00–11:00am PDT (UTC-7)
- Wed Jul 30, 2:00–3:00pm PDT
- Thu Jul 31, 8:30–9:30am PDT

If none of those work, send over two windows that fit your team and we can adjust. We'll upload a draft evidence matrix and a simple network diagram before the call so your team can pre-read.

Attachments we'll share ahead: SOC2_evidence_matrix.xlsx (stub), redwood-network-diagram.pdf (stub).

Thanks — looking forward.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

On Tue, Jul 29, 2025 at 9:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alice —
> 
> Thanks for taking this through with us...

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the agenda. We definitely want Derek (platform lead) and our SecOps alias on the call. The Wed Jul 30 morning slot conflicts with our leadership sync. Would Thu Jul 31 at 9:00–10:00am PDT work instead? Derek is in PDT as well.

A couple of asks for the pre-read: can you include the expected file paths/names for audit log exports and an example KMS key rotation record? Also please confirm if the call will be recorded (we like to drop into our compliance repository).

Appreciate it —
Alice
Director, Compliance — Clearwave Health
alice.j@clearwave.com | +1 (617) 555-2424

From: Olga PetroV <olga.p@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.j@clearwave.com>, Derek Li <derek.li@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security architecture review — SOC 2 evidence kickoff

Thanks Alice — Thu Jul 31 9:00–10:00am PDT works for us. I just created a calendar invite and shared a short Drive folder with the pre-read artifacts: network diagram, a starter evidence matrix, and a sample audit-log-export README. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDef_GhIjKlMno

Notes on the pre-read:
- Audit logs: we will include example JSON lines for audit events and the S3 path convention (s3://redwood-exports/tenant/clearwave/YYYY/MM/DD/). We also include a sample Splunk/Datadog forwarding configuration.
- KMS: attached is an excerpt showing key rotation metadata (rotation date, version, CMK id) and our envelope encryption pattern.
- SSO: short diagram of our Okta SAML flow plus SCIM provisioning mapping for user -> role.

Could you confirm the system owners who should be on the call (application owner, platform owner)? If you prefer, we'll keep it to 1–2 engineers and your compliance lead and do a follow-up workshop with more engineers.

Attachments uploaded to Drive and also attached here as stubs: SOC2_evidence_matrix.xlsx, redwood-network-diagram.pdf.

—Olga
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.p@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga PetroV <olga.p@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Final confirmation — Thu Jul 31 09:00 PDT (SOC 2 architecture review)

Thanks all — confirming Thu Jul 31, 2025 at 9:00am–10:00am PDT. We'll record the session and drop the recording link into the Drive folder for your compliance repository.

Quick agenda addendum: we'll bring an excerpt of our KMS rotation history (sanitized), an example audit log query you can run in the first 30 days, and the policy names for retention (e.g., audit-logs-retain-90d, audit-logs-retain-365d). If Derek shares any specific systems or endpoints you'd like us to show, we'll make sure they're part of the architecture walk.

Marissa will be the primary presenter; Olga will handle evidence mapping and file locations. I'll be on for any controls/ops questions.

See you Thursday — invite should be in your calendars.

—Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
